name: Rajasthan NDS/LT-2 above 5 kW, 2025 (with ToD)
source: Rajasthan NDS/LT-2 above 5 kW, RERC 'Tariff for Supply of Electricity-2025' (effective 1.10.2025, text from the Jodhpur discom's publication of the state schedule): marginal 8.50 Rs/kWh above 100 units; ToD for load above 10 kW: 12-16 -10%, 06-08 +5%, 18-22 +10%; fixed charges not modelled; export rate NOT from the order

notes: A state schedule of the Rajasthan regulator, text taken from the Jodhpur discom's publication; it is not specific to one discom here.
Fixed charges are not loaded, so a bill from this plan is energy charges only.
The source states no end date; a newer order may have replaced it.
The export rate is an assumption, not a figure from the order.
